Pursuant to the direction given by this Court in order dated 23.12.2025, the main case is listed today.

02. Motor Accident Claims Tribunal-(MACT), Jammu, by virtue of an award dated 03.10.2023, has awarded compensation for an amount of Rs. 98,42,800/- along with interest @ 7.5 % per annum in favour of the claimants from the date of filing of claim petition on file No. 111/C instituted on Director General Of Police J&K vs Gul Nisha Begum & Ors on 24 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/110377003/
1 07.03.2018.
03.

entities.text: Director General Of Police J&K vs Gul Nisha Begum & Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The award has been passed against the State of Jammu and Kashmir through Director General of Police as respondent No. 1 as the owner of the offending vehicle and employer of the offending driver.
04. A time-barred appeal under section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 came to be preferred on 21.11.2024 before this Court accompanied by condonation of delay application.

05. The condonation of delay application CM No. 6850/2024 came to be allowed and the appeal came to be taken on record in terms of an order dated 27.11.2024 with a direction for the appellant to deposit the entire awarded amount along with updated interest co-relating with the stay of operation of the impugned award.

06. Since the requisite deposit did not come forward, as such, the execution of the award was taken out which resulted in an order dated 18.12.2025 passed by the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal-(MACT), Jammu thereby directing debit of an amount of Rs. 1,51,25,100/- into three different accounts related to the claimants.

07. Mrs. Monika Kohli, learned Senior AAG submits that an application has been filed seeking a direction to withhold the transfer of the awarded amount into said accounts of the claimants/respondents No. 1 to 3.
08.

This Court directs the Registrar Judicial, Jammu to get the record of execution file titled "Gul Nisha Begum & Ors. Vs. State of J&K through Director General of Police & Anr." from the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal-(MACT), Jammu positively on 26.12.2025.
09.
